name: Форсований напад: звільнення лінії
description:
In this lesson, we will focus on clearing. With tempo you make space for a piece, after which you have the opportunity to set up a pin. We have seen both square clearance and line clearance. In this lesson we focus on square clearance. See example 1.

What do you have to do?

Clear a square with tempo and then gain material thanks to a pin.

examples.text: We combine several themes here. First White chases away the bishop with the pawn, freeing the g2-square for the bishop. Then white wins material with a pin.

texts: Prepare a pin with a forcing move.
